title: Sui DeFi protocol Full Sail to wind down after Switchboard incident
summary: Full Sail is shutting down after an attacker removed about $91,000 from three vaults during a security incident linked to oracle provider Switchboard.

title: BTC will hit $1M by 2030... but Arthur Hayes is buying ETH instead
summary: Arthur Hayes says Bitcoin is going to grind higher from here, but Ethereum is his number one pick due to its potential to increase “3x to 5x pretty quickly.”

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Hashkey joins DTCC working group as first Asian crypto service provider
summary: Hashkey joined the DTCC’s working group on tokenization innovation as the first Asian crypto service provider to join with over 100 financial institutions, including Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan.

title: Thai businessmen sue Tether for freezing $42M in $61M pig butchering case
summary: The plaintiffs didn’t dispute their involvement in the pig butchering scam, but claimed that Tether did not have the authority to freeze the $42 million at the time.

title: Japan’s Remixpoint dumps altcoins, leaves 1,506 BTC as sole crypto bet
summary: Remixpoint sold $5.5 million in ETH, SOL, XRP and DOGE, booking a $736,000 net gain as it narrowed its crypto strategy to focus on Bitcoin.

title: Thailand adopts crypto Travel Rule with self-custodial wallet checks
summary: Thailand adopted a crypto Travel Rule requiring digital asset operators to verify control of self-custodial wallets and retain transaction data for five years.

title: Crypto industry urges SEC to avoid blanket novel ETF restrictions
summary: Grayscale, a16z, and the CCI asked the SEC to preserve existing classification rules and avoid treating novel exchange-traded products as a single category, while proposing different routes to clearer and faster reviews.

title: Bitcoin ETFs notch best month of 2026 as BTC gains 25% in August
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs reduced their year-to-date net outflows by 66% as Bitcoin gained about 25% in August, while Ether ETFs turned positive YTD at $732 million and XRP ETFs reached $502 million.

title: HYPE treasury firm Hyperliquid Strategies boosts equity facility to $2.5B
summary: The Nasdaq-listed company previously raised $647 million through the facility and accumulated about 29.3 million HYPE tokens.
